added.summary: A document element's `part` takes a list of names, as in HTML (`part="Bag.portrait Bag.picture"`): `::part()` reaches it by any of them, the document's own `[part~="Bag.portrait"]` by one, and it wears the role of its last name. Every name is in the document's `parts` line.

Three new roles: `name` (`--name-font/size/tracking/transform/ink/shadow/selected-ink`), `picture` (`--picture-fill/rim/rim-width/radius/shadow`) and `tab`, which wears the core tabs' `--tabs-tab-*` and `--tabs-font/tracking/transform`. The name and picture hooks are unset by default, so the components' own look stands until a pack sets them.
